title: eDNA metabarcoding of mangrove fish assemblages in Siargao dataset
author: Mayenne Balaba
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Prepare decontamination and controls
steps.instruction: Implement stringent field decontamination procedures and include negative controls to prevent cross‑site contamination throughout sampling and laboratory work.

steps.title: Collect paired water samples
steps.instruction: At each of the 14 mangrove stations (covering 7 coastal sites) under neap tide conditions, collect two 1 L surface water samples.

steps.title: Measure in‑situ environmental variables
steps.instruction: Record salinity and temperature at each station using calibrated multiparameter probes.

steps.title: Filter water through Sterivex
steps.instruction: Filter each 1 L sample through a 0.22 µm Sterivex filter using sterile filtration equipment, following the established decontamination protocol to avoid cross‑site contamination.

steps.title: Extract DNA from filters
steps.instruction: Extract environmental DNA from each Sterivex filter with the Qiagen DNEasy PowerWater kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Amplify 12S rRNA region
steps.instruction: Perform two successive PCR amplifications of the fish 12S rRNA region using the MiFish‑U2, MiFish‑U, and MiFish‑E‑v2 primer sets together with KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (Roche).

substeps.instruction: Set up the first PCR reaction with the three primer sets and KAPA HiFi ReadyMix.
Run the first PCR under the recommended cycling conditions.
Use the first‑PCR product as template for a second PCR with the same primers and ReadyMix.
Run the second PCR under the same cycling conditions.

steps.title: Sequence amplicons on iSeq
steps.instruction: Pool the PCR products and sequence them on an Illumina iSeq 100 platform to obtain 160 bp paired‑end reads.

steps.title: Process raw sequence data
steps.instruction: Import the raw reads into QIIME 2, denoise and remove chimeras with DADA2, then cluster the resulting features with VSEARCH to generate high‑resolution amplicon sequence variants (ASVs).

substeps.instruction: Run DADA2 for denoising and chimera removal.
Cluster denoised sequences with VSEARCH to obtain ASVs.

steps.title: Assign taxonomy to ASVs
steps.instruction: Perform BLASTn searches of each ASV against GenBank and assign taxonomy using identity thresholds ranging from species to class level.

steps.title: Conduct statistical diversity analyses
steps.instruction: Apply PERMANOVA, beta‑dispersion test, distance‑based redundancy analysis (dbRDA), and indicator species analysis to the ASV table to calculate alpha and beta diversities.

steps.title: Integrate ecological trait data
steps.instruction: Enrich the ASV dataset with ecological traits and conservation information sourced from FishBase, IUCN, and relevant literature.
